svg.aria-label: AI Mock Interviewer: Mock interview platform that tailors questions and grades answers with the Gemini API. Questions tailored to role and experience; Gemini-graded answers with feedback; Sessions and scores stored in PostgreSQL. Built with Next.js, Tailwind CSS, Gemini API, PostgreSQL, Drizzle.
